entities.summary: Song Puxuan (b. 1954-03-01, Boxing County) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Boxing County and China. Known in the fields of china, military leaders & commanders, asia.
